mechanism_narrative: The steady two-week rise in WORKPLACES from -22.1 to -12.0 percent below baseline signals restored commuting and office routines; this lifts weekday retail-and-recreation footfall, so RETAIL_REC rises over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC mean over the next 28 days is not higher than its mean over the last 28 days when WORKPLACES has risen for two consecutive weeks.

mechanism_narrative: A week-on-week PARKS drop greater than 8 points, as seen from -13.4 to -21.7, signals imminent tightening of outdoor gathering rules or voluntary avoidance; retail-and-recreation mobility then falls over the next two weeks.
candidate_trigger: PARKS falls more than 8 points week-on-week
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 14 days is equal to or higher than its last 14-day mean following a PARKS weekly drop greater than 8 points.

mechanism_narrative: Joint recovery in TRANSIT and WORKPLACES, with both series improving for two consecutive weeks, creates reinforcing commuting and station-footfall flows that lift discretionary retail visits over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT above -30 and WORKPLACES above -15 simultaneously
failure_condition: When TRANSIT is above -30 and WORKPLACES above -15, RETAIL_REC mean over the next 28 days is not higher than its last 28-day mean.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained GROCERY_PHARM above baseline indicates households are still in essential-only shopping mode; discretionary retail-and-recreation trips are crowded out, so RETAIL_REC declines over the next two weeks.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM remains above 0 percent for two consecutive weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC mean over the next 14 days is higher than its last 14-day mean while GROCERY_PHARM stays above 0 percent for two consecutive weeks.

failure_condition: RETAIL_REC mean over the next 28 days is not higher than its last 28-day mean when RESIDENTIAL is below +17 and WORKPLACES above -15.

mechanism_narrative: A PARKS reading below -20, as in the latest week, reflects a seasonal outdoor-avoidance regime; displaced outdoor trips shift to indoor malls, raising RETAIL_REC over the next week.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 7 days is not higher than its last 7-day mean whenever PARKS is below -20 percent.

failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 7 days is equal to or higher than its last 7-day mean when PARKS is below -20 and GROCERY_PHARM is above 0.
